description: Defines the BuzzComment entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including properties, ORM mappings, and methods related to comments on a social feature.

classes.name: BuzzComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a comment in the Buzz social feature, with ORM mappings and methods for managing comment data.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the comment.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who made the comment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who made the comment.

methods.name: getNumOfLikes
methods.description: Returns the number of likes for the comment.

methods.name: setNumOfLikes
methods.description: Sets the number of likes for the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the creation time of the comment in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation time of the comment to current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the last update time of the comment in UTC.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the update time of the comment to current UTC time.
